narrative.details:
You have slain my husband, friend! My child will be born into this world without a father.

<Princess Moira points directly at you.>

I assure you, this child will be the next ruler of the kingdom of Ironforge. You and your kind shall be hunted down until the end of days for this wrongful act.

<You think that Princess Moira may be suffering from the residual effect of Thaurissan's spell.>

Leave me be, friend. I am certain your warchief will be eager to hear the results of his meddling.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Thrall is taken aback by the information you have presented to him.>A new threat now looms on the horizon. As Magni's years dwindle down, the way shall be opened for this unborn Dark Iron to become ruler of Ironforge.You have accomplished what I asked of you and for that, you shall be rewarded.Now leave me, adventurer! I must confer with Sylvanas and Cairne.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 52 to 60, 41,000 XP in all.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron.

quests.name: Commander Gor'shak
quests.objectiveText: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping.

quests.name: The Eastern Kingdoms
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.objectiveText: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.
